function.arguments: {"finding": "The channel was not randomly assigned — the email campaign was deliberately targeted at loyal customers, who have higher baseline conversion rates. The unadjusted comparison shows email has a higher conversion rate (38.8% vs 31.3%), but this is confounded by customer segment. After standardizing to the overall segment distribution, the weighted conversion rate for email is lower than for paid search (26.5% vs 39.6%), reversing the apparent effect.", "implication": "The unadjusted difference is misleading. A confounded comparison can give the opposite sign to the truth. We must use standardization to adjust for the confounder (customer_segment) before comparing channels. function.name: note_finding
